name: Microsoft Entra ID (directory roles, ELIGIBLE through PIM)

prerequisites.roleAssignableGroup: The PIM group must be role-assignable (isAssignableToRole=true at creation; immutable afterward) to be made eligible for an Entra directory role. CreateUpdate-PIM-Group sets this for PIM- groups that map to directory roles.
prerequisites.noActivationNeeded: Entra directory RBAC is always on; built-in roles always present.
prerequisites.eligibleThroughPim: SEC-45: this connector NEVER creates a permanent active directory-role assignment. It used to POST /roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments -- a standing assignment made OUTSIDE PIM, exactly what the product exists to prevent, and it was offered in the Manager's workload picker. The group is now made ELIGIBLE through a PIM eligibility schedule request (roleEligibilityScheduleRequests, action adminAssign); its members still ACTIVATE the role under the role's PIM policy (MFA, justification, approval, maximum duration). The role policy decides whether a no-expiry eligibility is allowed; if it is not, the request is refused and the engine reports the failure item.
prerequisites.removal: A Remove row is REPORTED, not applied: an eligibility carries no 'created by PIM4EntraPS' marker, so the workload runtime never deletes it (the v1 rule for flat assignments). Remove it in Entra ID -> Privileged Identity Management, or manage directory-role delegation through PIM-Assignments-Roles-Groups, which the engine applies and prunes itself.
